name: Chery car plant with Mermerler (Sakarya)
summary: Chery's Turkish distributor Mermerler Otomotiv repeatedly announced a 500–550m USD car plant in Sakarya (Karasu/Adapazarı) from 2008 to 2011; the archive shows delays and site/permit issues but no production start.

name: İzmir Port privatisation (Global–Hutchison–EİB)
summary: Hong Kong's Hutchison was in the Global–Hutchison–EİB consortium that won İzmir Port's 49-year concession for 1.275bn USD in 2007; after court delays the consortium did not take over the port.

name: Chinese purchases of marble quarries (unnamed buyers)
summary: Exporter associations reported Chinese firms buying and operating marble quarries (about 100 in Antalya, Burdur and Isparta by 2014); buyers are never named.

name: ADM Capital stake in STFA Yatırım Holding
summary: A 2008 article reports that 21% of STFA Yatırım Holding was sold to Hong Kong-based ADM Capital.

name: Chinese coal/chrome exploration partnerships (2008)
summary: Reports of Chinese investors forming partnerships for coal exploration (Manisa) and chrome deposits (Erdemli).

name: Li & Fung textile project in Southeastern Anatolia
summary: Li & Fung said in 2008 it planned to revive idle textile capacity in the GAP region with Arslan Group.

name: Li & Fung Istanbul regional HQ
summary: Li & Fung opened its Istanbul headquarters building in Bahçelievler in 2010 (400 staff), running Europe/North Africa sourcing.

name: Akkuyu nuclear tender – Chinese spec buyer (2008)
summary: A Chinese company bought the 2008 Akkuyu tender documents but did not submit a bid.

name: TBEA investment interest (solar, turbines)
summary: TBEA expressed interest in solar investment (2008) and gave PM Erdoğan an 'investment promise' in Urumqi (2012); no project followed in the archive.

name: Dongfeng (DFM) light-commercial-vehicle plant
summary: The Investment Support Agency announced a 250m USD DFM plant (52,000 vehicles/yr, 1,000 jobs) in 2009; no later evidence of construction.

name: Chinese automaker plant in Konya (unnamed)
summary: Minister Çağlayan said in 2009 a Chinese automaker would build a plant with a Turkish partner, possibly in Konya.

name: Chinese stake in Yavuz Sultan Selim Bridge & North Marmara Motorway
investor: China Merchants Expressway; Jiangsu Expressway; Zhejiang Expressway
summary: A Chinese consortium agreed in Dec 2019 to buy 51% of the bridge operator ICA for about 659–689m USD; in Aug 2021 IC Holding suspended talks pending refinancing.

name: Şırnak coal plant – Chinese builder with 10% stake
summary: Galata Enerji signed a 355m USD EPC contract with CMEC (2010); in 2012 it said the Chinese builder had been given a 10% partnership.

name: 'Anadolu' phone with Lenovo Mobile (Erzincan)
summary: Anatolia Telekom announced a Chinese-partnered domestic phone to be produced in Erzincan (2010).

name: Huawei Istanbul R&D centre
summary: Huawei opened its Ümraniye R&D centre in 2010 (planned >50m USD in 3 years); it reported 120m USD by 2016 and 520m TL over 10 years, with 400+ engineers.

name: Geely investment plan with Anadolu Group
summary: ISPAT listed Geely as planning investment in Turkey with Anadolu Group (2010).

name: Hisense production plan with Anadolu Group
summary: Hisense entered the market via Anadolu Group's Antek and said it wanted a Turkish production facility (2010).

name: SANY and three other Chinese firms near investment decision
summary: Minister Ergün said in 2010 that SANY and three other Chinese firms were about to decide on investments.

name: JAC electric-vehicle investment interest
summary: JAC said in 2011 it wanted to invest in Turkey, especially in EVs.

name: Zhejiang Energy–Polat coal mine & power plant (Soma)
summary: A protocol for a >1bn USD coal mine and power plant in Soma/Kınık was signed in 2011, billed as the first big Chinese FDI.

name: Alibaba.com market entry via partnership
summary: Alibaba.com entered Turkey through a local partnership (2011).

name: ADM Capital–Yıldız partnership in Dardanel
summary: Dardanel's capital rose from 34.8m to 85m TL with shares allotted to an ADM Capital–Yıldız vehicle (2011).

name: China's bid for the Sinop nuclear plant
summary: China negotiated for Turkey's second nuclear plant in Sinop in 2012–13; the project went to the Japanese–French consortium.

name: CNR investment in Malatya wagon repair factory
summary: Malatya governor signed a goodwill agreement with China's CNR (2012).

name: Sinovel turbine supply and localisation invitation
summary: Ağaoğlu agreed to buy turbines for 600 MW and invited Sinovel to produce components in Turkey (2012).

name: ENN in Başkent Doğalgaz privatisation
summary: STFA bid for Başkent Gaz with China's ENN via a 50-50 company (2012); the archive does not show them winning.

name: JAC–İhlas SKD assembly in Yalova
summary: İhlas Motor agreed with JAC to assemble 3.5-t LCVs in its Yalova plant (2012); no Chinese equity is reported.

name: Tufanbeyli lignite power plant (TEYO and Chinese partner)
summary: TEYO and its Chinese partner signed a 30-year royalty deal for a 600 MW, 1.2bn USD plant at Tufanbeyli (2012).

name: Riot Games Turkey office (Tencent-controlled)
summary: Riot Games, majority-owned by Tencent since 2011, opened a direct Turkey office in 2012.

name: China Sunergy solar panel factory plan
summary: China Sunergy announced a 600m USD, 600 MW panel factory with Akfel and Seul Enerji (2012).

name: HNA Group in myTECHNIC and myCARGO
summary: HNA co-owns the MRO firm myTECHNIC at Sabiha Gökçen (founder holds 40%) and partners in myCARGO (2012).

name: Turkish–Chinese industrial park in Niğde Bor
summary: Plans for ~200 Chinese factories and 15,000 jobs at Bor OSB were reported in 2012.

name: Hong Kong hotel brands (management)
summary: Hong Kong-based hotel groups operate hotels in Istanbul and Bodrum; the articles describe brand/management roles, not ownership.

name: Isparta–Xingtai lithium battery JV
summary: Isparta Municipality formed Isparta Gül Ltd (51%) with Chinese partners (49%) for a lithium battery factory (2012).

name: Cenhan Madencilik copper mine (Malatya)
summary: A Chinese company took 10-year operating rights to a copper site in Arguvan (2012).

name: Kingdom linen yarn factory idea
summary: The Chinese linen yarn maker said a factory and flax growing in Turkey could be studied (2012).

name: ADM Capital partnership in Işıklar Holding
summary: ADM Capital partnered with Işıklar Holding from about 2006 and exited in January 2012.

name: Harbin Electric–Hattat power-equipment JV
summary: Harbin Electric and Hattat's HEMA signed a 250m USD, 50-50 JV to make power-plant equipment, targeting 2,000 jobs (2012).

name: Chinese interest in Istanbul's third airport
summary: Minister Yıldırım listed Chinese firms among those interested in the third-airport tender (2012).

name: Texhong yarn plant in Balıkesir OSB
summary: A Chinese yarn maker (Texhong) planned a 70–150m USD plant; Balıkesir OSB allocated land in 2013.

name: Chinese construction investment feasibility in Van
summary: A Chinese firm with a local partner set aside 12m TL for a feasibility study in Van (2012).

name: Earlier Chinese investment in Mardin OSB (unnamed)
summary: Mardin officials said the OSB had earlier received investment from China (2012).

name: CMEC interest in electricity distribution
summary: Mainly an EPC contractor, CMEC said in 2013 it was eyeing electricity distribution.

name: Chinese bid for the Afşin-Elbistan coal complex
summary: Turkey negotiated a 10–12bn USD Afşin-Elbistan deal with China in 2013–16; no agreement is reported.

name: Chinese entrepreneur's shirt business (Sakarya)
summary: A Chinese national co-founded a made-to-measure shirt maker in Sakarya that began exporting (2014).

name: Chinese renewable firms seeking land in Silifke
summary: Silifke OSB received land requests from Chinese renewable-energy firms but could not meet them (2014).

name: Bank of China Turkey
summary: Bank of China opened liaison offices (2014), applied for a licence (2015-16) and received its operating licence in December 2017.

name: Sinotruk exploration visit
summary: Sinotruk visited in 2014 to explore production and trade options.

name: Chinese interest in Kanal İstanbul
summary: Officials held preliminary talks with Chinese firms on Kanal İstanbul (2014-15).

name: BYD e-bus production base idea
summary: BYD said in 2014 it was studying Turkey as a production base for electric buses.

name: ICBC acquisition of Tekstilbank (ICBC Turkey)
summary: ICBC agreed in 2014 to buy 75.5% of Tekstilbank for 669m TL, completed in May 2015 (renamed ICBC Turkey), then doubled its capital in 2016.

name: LiuGong investment decision (construction machinery)
summary: A sector article said LiuGong had decided to invest in Turkey's construction-machinery sector (2014).

name: XCMG investment decision (construction machinery)
summary: A sector article said XCMG had decided to invest in Turkey's construction-machinery sector (2014).

name: ADM Capital in Turkish healthcare
summary: ADM Capital is listed among funds that entered the Turkish health sector (2014).

name: SNPTC–Westinghouse third nuclear plant (Thrace)
summary: EÜAŞ, Westinghouse and China's SNPTC signed an MoU in 2014 for a third nuclear plant (İğneada); talks continued to 2019.

name: Risen Solar feasibility in Van
summary: Risen Solar sent a team to Van for a solar-investment feasibility study (2014).

name: China Road and Bridge Turkey office
summary: CRBC has a Turkey general manager (2015); later bid for the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge.

name: ChemChina control of Pirelli/Prometeon (İzmit)
summary: ChemChina took control of Pirelli in 2015 (with Türk Pirelli in İzmit); spin-off Prometeon spent 115m USD in İzmit in 2017–20 and planned 40m USD more.

name: ICBC plan to take over HSBC Turkey branches
summary: A 2015 press report said ICBC planned to take over 277 HSBC Turkey branches.

name: Xinjiang Alkut health-tourism investment (Kızılcahamam)
summary: Alkut set up Urumçi Tarım AŞ in Ankara for a >100m USD thermal health and herbal medicine investment (2015).

name: Chinese partners in Humartaş renewable projects
summary: Humartaş said it runs joint projects with Chinese firms and that panel makers provide funding (2015).

name: Peninsula hotel at Galataport
summary: HSH filed a JV with the Galataport developer to develop and operate The Peninsula Istanbul, funding 150m EUR of 300m EUR.

name: COSCO-led acquisition of Kumport
summary: A COSCO Pacific-led consortium bought 65% of Kumport (Ambarlı) for 940m USD in 2015, then the largest Chinese FDI in Turkey.

name: New Hope feed factory (Adana)
summary: New Hope opened an animal-feed factory in Adana OSB in 2015.

name: Chinese interest in a 1,320 MW coal plant
summary: The EPDK head said Chinese firms wanted to build a 1,320 MW coal plant and other energy assets (2015).

name: Enerjisa stake sale to Chinese (rumour)
summary: Sabancı said in 2016 there was no decision on reported Enerjisa share sales to Chinese investors.

name: HNA control of Ingram Micro (Turkey unit)
summary: Turkey's Competition Board cleared HNA's takeover of Ingram Micro, including its Turkish operations (2016).

name: Chinese bidders in Karapınar YEKA solar
summary: Two consortia with Chinese members bid in the 2017 1,000 MW Karapınar YEKA; Kalyon–Hanwha won.

name: ZTE acquisition of Netaş
summary: ZTE bought 48.04% of Netaş from OEP for 101.3m USD (signed Dec 2016, closed Jul 2017), then announced new investments and local production.

name: CRBC in the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge tender
investor: China Road and Bridge Corp (with Cengiz–Kolin)
summary: CRBC bid with Cengiz and Kolin for the bridge BOT in 2017; the Daelim–Limak–SK–Yapı Merkezi group won.

name: Wanda–Mar Yapı cooperation (Wanda Vista Istanbul)
summary: Wanda signed a strategic cooperation with Mar Yapı, starting with a Wanda Vista hotel in Istanbul (2017).

name: KUKA Turkey (Midea-controlled)
summary: KUKA, controlled by China's Midea since 2017, has a Turkey country manager.

name: Chinese firms seeking Turkish pasta makers
summary: Chinese firms were reported to be in talks to buy Turkish pasta makers (2017).

name: PowerChina Eurasia HQ in Istanbul
summary: PowerChina decided to locate its Eurasia regional HQ (63 countries) in Istanbul (2017).

name: StarTimes seeks Turkish partner
summary: StarTimes said in 2017 it was preparing to invest and looking for a Turkish partner.

name: Hanergy solar panel factory (Çankırı)
summary: Hanergy agreed with Çankırı officials on a panel factory (≈500 jobs) and 300 MW energy park at Yakınkent OSB (2017).

name: Goldwind and MingYang in YEKA wind tender
summary: Goldwind (with Akfen–Beyçelik) and MingYang bid in the 1,000 MW wind YEKA (2017) but did not win.

name: Feilo Sylvania Turkey office
summary: Sylvania, bought by China's Feilo in 2016, opened a Turkey office in 2017.

name: Chinese/HK investors in Ağaoğlu Bodrum project
investor: Chinese construction group; HK financial investor
summary: Ağaoğlu signed a preliminary agreement with a Chinese construction group and a Hong Kong investor for its Bodrum tourism city (2017).

summary: Chinese-owned Benelli agreed with Kuba Motor to make Turkey its third production site, using Kuba's Gaziantep plant (2017).

name: Chinese bank interest in DenizBank (rumour)
summary: Bloomberg reported a Chinese bank was interested in DenizBank (2018); Emirates NBD bought it.

name: Shenhua–DEI bid for Eskişehir thermal plant
summary: Greece's DEI said it bid with Shenhua for an Eskişehir thermal plant (2018).

name: Shanghai Electric's EMBA Hunutlu power plant
summary: A Shanghai Electric Power-led consortium signed contracts in 2018 for the 1,320 MW EMBA Hunutlu plant; ministers called it one of China's largest direct investments in Turkey.

name: Chinese interest in Türk Telekom 55% (rumour)
summary: Reports in 2018 said a Chinese company (Tatwah) was in talks for the 55% Türk Telekom stake held by lenders.

name: Zorlu–GSR Capital battery plant
status: Preliminary agreement – not realised in archive
summary: Zorlu and China's GSR Capital signed a preliminary deal for a 4.5bn USD battery plant (2018).

name: ZTT cable plants and Demirer Kablo acquisition
summary: ZTT announced 110m USD of cable investments (2018) and bought Demirer Kablo in Bilecik for 66.7m USD.

name: HT Solar panel factory
summary: Chinese state-owned HT Solar runs panel factories in Turkey (600 MW in 2018, 1,200 MW/yr by 2021) and bid in YEKA.

name: Alibaba Cloud via E-Glober
summary: Alibaba Cloud entered Turkey through a partnership with E-Glober (2018).

summary: Alibaba became Trendyol's majority owner in 2018 (the deal article itself is missing from the archive) and added 350m USD of capital in 2021 (86.5% stake).

summary: Eti Maden's boron carbide plant uses Dalian Jinma technology and is built by CMEC; the plant is state-owned.

name: Kerry Logistics in Turkey (ASAV)
summary: Kerry Logistics invested in China–Turkey road/rail services (2018) and bought a majority of ASAV Lojistik (2019).

name: Chinese manufacturer partner in Reeder's Samsun plant
summary: Reeder said it set up its Samsun phone plant with support from its Chinese manufacturer, on EBRD advice to take a strategic partner (2018).

name: Haier white-goods factory (Eskişehir)
summary: Haier began building a factory in Eskişehir OSB in 2019; President Erdoğan opened it in October 2021.

name: H3C office and planned factory
summary: H3C opened a Turkey office, signed distribution with Boğaziçi Bilgisayar (2020) and was deciding on a factory (200+ jobs) in 2021.

name: Siro battery JV (Togg–Farasis)
summary: Togg chose Farasis in 2020; their JV Siro will make battery cells and modules in Gemlik (15 GWh), with project-based state aid from 2021.

name: OPPO smartphone plant (Tuzla)
summary: OPPO announced about 50m USD of investment in December 2020, got an incentive certificate (121m TL, 3.5m phones/yr) and began test production in Tuzla in March 2021.

name: TECNO smartphone plant (Pendik)
summary: TECNO invested 25–35m USD in a Pendik plant and began production in 2021, targeting about 1,000 jobs.

name: Xiaomi–Salcomp smartphone plant (Avcılar)
summary: Xiaomi and Salcomp (owned by China's Luxshare) opened a 30m USD plant in Avcılar in March 2021 (5m phones/yr, 2,000 jobs).

name: TCL phones co-produced with Arçelik
summary: TCL began SKD phone production with Arçelik at Çerkezköy OSB in 2021 (450,000/yr); no Chinese equity is reported.

name: vivo smartphone plant (Gebze)
summary: vivo began production at a 20m USD plant in Gebze Güzeller OSB in August 2021 (up to 5m phones/yr).

name: Sinovac vaccine local production talks
summary: The health minister said investment and technology-transfer talks were held with China on producing Sinovac in Turkey (Sept 2021); in Nov 2021 the Competition Board cleared a JV between Sinovac (Hainan) Life Sciences and Alagöz Holding.

name: Gate.io Turkey operations
summary: Gate.io started official operations in Turkey in 2022 and named a country manager.

name: AVIC EPC framework for Hattat Amasra plant
summary: Contractor role (1bn USD EPC framework, 2012).

name: Zhejiang Orient agreement for Umutlu HES
summary: Agreement for a 21.5 MW hydro plant; the Chinese role is not stated (likely EPC).

name: Datong mining cooperation (Amasra)
summary: Contractor role in Hattat's Amasra coal mining (2012).

name: China Coal extraction contract (Amasra)
summary: 700m USD coal extraction contract (2013).

name: Chinese government HSR talks (Ankara–Istanbul)
summary: Government-to-government talks for a faster Ankara–Istanbul line (2013).

name: Chinese firms in Mersin rail finance-and-build talks
summary: Preliminary talks (2019).

name: Gezhouba EPC for Eğirdir pumped hydro
summary: 1.5bn USD EPC contract with KAF for a 1,000 MW pumped-storage plant (2020).

name: Swiss-Belhotel in Turkey (Çelik Palas)
summary: The Hong Kong chain entered via Bursa's Çelik Palas in 2015 and left in 2017.

name: Luoyang Yizong halal food partnership idea
summary: The Chinese halal meat producer said in 2012 it was considering a Turkish partnership and its own supermarket chain.

name: Energy group in talks with Chinese buyers (2015)
summary: A 2015 article said a large Turkish energy group was negotiating to sell its power companies to Chinese investors.
